create.name: Centro Tara Bianca
create.bio:
Centro Tara Bianca is a Tibetan Buddhist centre in the centre of Genoa, affiliated to the FPMT and the Italian Buddhist Union. It grew from a small group of practitioners without a fixed home, first named Sabsel Thekchok Ling, and took shape as a centre from 2010; when it joined the FPMT, Lama Zopa Rinpoche added the name Drolkar, Tibetan for White Tara. It follows the Gelug tradition under the spiritual guidance of the Dalai Lama and publicly rejects Shugden practice. Its resident teacher is Geshe Konchog Kyab, born in Sikkim in 1961 to Tibetan refugee parents, who trained at Sera Je monastery and served there as discipline master.

The centre runs a regular calendar of teachings by its geshe, by ordained teachers and by lay members of the sangha. There are evening classes on the Lam Rim, using Pabongka Rinpoche's Liberation in the Palm of Your Hand, studies of mind and cognition (lorig) and of Shantideva's Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, guided analytical and concentration meditation on alternate Sundays, and Guru Puja and other group practices. Members can also follow the teachings by live stream. The YouTube channel keeps older recordings of visiting geshes and of Robina Courtin on emptiness, the bardo and the three principal aspects of the path.

courses.title: LAM RIM – “La Liberazione nel palmo della tua mano”
courses.description: An evening series in which Geshe Konchog Kyab comments in depth on Pabongka Rinpoche's Lam Rim text, covering precious human life, death and impermanence, karma and the six perfections; intermediate level.

courses.title: Meditazioni guidate con il Ven. Geshe Konchog Kyab
courses.description: Guided analytical and concentration meditation on alternate Sunday mornings, in which the resident teacher explains the objects of meditation, how to practise correctly and how to bring meditation into daily life.

courses.title: Diventa Socio
courses.description: Ordinary membership of the association, which gives access to the centre, its activities and library, the resident teacher's teachings and the live streams, with a vote in the assembly.
